payload.artist_html: Martín D. Ezcurra, Saswati Bandyopadhyay, Dhurjati P. Sengupta, Kasturi Sen, Andrey G. Sennikov, Roland B. Sookias, Sterling J. Nesbitt and Richard J. Butler
payload.description_html: Comparison between anterior caudal vertebrae of selected Early and Middle Triassic non-eucrocopodan archosauriforms. (a–c) Chasmatosuchus rossicus (PIN 2243/167), (d–f, i) Chasmatosuchus rossicus (PIN 2252/384), (g, h, j) Erythrosuchus africanus (NHMUK PV R3592), and (k–n) Garjainia prima (PIN 951/65) in (a, g, k) right lateral, (b, e, h, m) dorsal, (c, i, j, n) ventral, (d) left lateral, (f) posterior, and (l) anterior views. f.ha, facet for haemal arch; fo, fossa; ns, neural spine; posf, postspinal fossa; poz, postzygapophysis; prsf, prespinal fossa; prz, prezygapophysis; tp, transverse process. Scale bars equal 1 cm.
